purpose: 5章を貫くNPCハルさん（定食屋を開きたい人）の立ち絵。会話・discovery・E画面で反復登場
scene: A friendly Japanese adult in their early 30s who dreams of opening a small teishoku (set-meal) diner. Warm, hopeful smile. Wearing a clean modern navy apron over casual clothes, holding a round wooden serving tray with a small clay bowl of rice and a tiny miso soup bowl on it (clearly a diner cook-to-be). Gender-ambiguous styling, short neat hair. CRITICAL series-match fixes (from reference comparison): small simple dot eyes with NO gloss highlights; matte clay skin with subtle handmade surface irregularity (never smooth CG skin); hair as ONE simplified solid clay mass with minimal grooves; apron and clothes read as molded matte clay (no fabric weave texture); the figure must look like a handcrafted clay figurine standing in a toy-diorama world, NOT a studio 3D character portrait.
composition: UPPER BODY ONLY (waist-up), centered, LOTS of empty margin: the head top must be well below the top edge (at least 15% headroom) and the waist crop well above the bottom edge. Plain very light warm background (soft cream). CRITICAL: chibi clay-figure proportions of this series — big round head, small body, about 2.5 heads tall in full (so the visible waist-up is mostly head and chest), simplified mitten-like hands.
required_objects: round wooden serving tray with rice bowl and miso soup
character_constraints: modern, kind adult; series chibi clay proportions (2.5-3 heads), NOT realistic proportions; no gender-stereotyped exaggeration
